title: Mixed Event — Get Fit & Fly! Muscle Training!

meta.Outline: Haruka thinks of ways to make exercise fun for MORE MORE JUMP!'s fans. By chance, she meets Tsukasa, who invites her to the athletic event Shinobi Battle!

rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Line: (MEIKO's absolutely right.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: Haruka

<Yes, that's what I like to hear.
I believe in you, Haruka!>

rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Alright...

rows.Line: (I feel much better now after talking to MEIKO, so I'll keep running and...)

I might take this opportunity to up my distance a little. Running a new route should help take my mind off what's been happening.)

rows.Line: Good idea. The exercises we do make us better dancers and help keep us in shape, so there should be plenty of interest.

rows.Line: Plus, we need to keep training in order to put on better performances moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, I agree! Let's do it!

rows.Speaker: Haruka

The proper machines and equipment?

rows.Line: I'm gonna try more and more and more to learn how to perform cool dances like you, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Where'd all that motivation from a second ago disappear to?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (The others have all been really motivated since we began training for Idol Lovers.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I need to do my best to keep up with them.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's called “Shinobi Battle”!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: “Shinobi Battle”...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's an obstacle course race that's open to the public.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Teams of three will be competing to see who can finish it the fastest.

rows.Line:
Really?
I didn't hear anything about that.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. The course even includes a part of the new athletic area, so we're both very interested.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Overall, it looks very difficult. Each section is designed to test your various muscles.

rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see. The new athletic area...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It sounds like a difficult course, but also fun. And perfect for a stream...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wow...

rows.Line: Alright, we're all here!

rows.Line: Kiritani, Akito, thank you both again for agreeing to do this. Especially you, Kiritani. I know I'm asking quite a lot of you.

Let's do our best!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, let's begin by reviewing the rules!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Shinobi Battle consists of three stages.
Each member will be assigned one, and teams will be competing for the fastest total time.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: In other words, we each just have to focus on finishing the stage we're assigned as fast as possible, right?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Right!
And members are allowed to choose which stage they'd like to tackle to prepare for it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I, Tsukasa Tenma, will be taking the first stage, which consists of the “spider walls” and the “log bridge”.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: For the spider walls, competitors are tasked with crossing a space using two walls that they will find on either side of them, without touching the ground.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, like an actual spider, you have to use your hands and feet to stay stuck to the walls. That's going to really test your arm and leg muscles.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, and the log bridge is no walk in the park either. It simply involves reaching the other side by balancing across a fallen log...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But if you slip at all, there is a very real possibility of falling off entirely.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But you've been doing quite a lot of strength training for your shows, Tenma. Tests of strength such as these are right up your alley.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, so you can leave the first stage to me!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That said, Akito's second stage isn't any easier. It involves the “high vault” and “water spider” obstacles.
